name: Starving‎ Apes
summary:
Trapped in an abandoned facility with flickering lights and empty vending machines, you are one of the last surviving apes. Hunger gnaws at your mind, but you’re not alone. Echoes of others—starving, desperate, and wild—stalk the dark halls. Scavenge for food, avoid the shadows, and uncover what really happened here before the hunger consumes you.
